run_evaluate_actions: run EPIC-Kitchens action evaluation with verb and noun prediction pickle files
compute_top_k_actions: compute top-k accuracy for verb-noun action predictions with optional prior
compute_top_k_verbs_or_nouns: compute top-k accuracy for verb or noun predictions separately
get_training_action_freq: estimate frequency of each verb-noun pair from EPIC-Kitchens training annotations
evaluate_actions: evaluate action performance by combining verb and noun predictions with softmax
